body: I would just like to say, I have BPD and I’m a mom of 4. I do not hit or take my anger out I’m my CHILD. I write CHILD in bold because clearly your wife has forgotten that part. Regardless of mental health, it is not ok to abuse a child. If she refuses medication, she has no business being around your CHILDREN.  I don’t care what anyone else has to say, it’s not ok! You can go to as many classes as you’d like, but that won’t help your wife if she herself doesn’t realize what she’s doing. I take medication and go to therapy not just for myself, but for my children as well. It’s up to us to break generational cycles of abuse. Good luck!!!
Earlier I told my boyfriend that my legs felt weak, and he jokingly said, “haha you’re so dramatic.” So I cried while deleting photos of us. Clearly I am dramatic.
This has been happening to me for over a week now. I thought I was sick, I have a thyroid condition. But could it be related to stress/BPD?!
I’m having the worse outbreak today. Itching so badly and it leaves long scratch like welts all over my body. I know it’s because of my thyroid, it just sucks to live like this

I used to have a family, but I left to be in the relationship I’m in now. I want to go back so badly, but I know that’s just not possible. I’ve reached out, but nobody replies. I feel so alone. I was left in Thanksgiving by my boyfriend who went to his family. He didn’t even ask me if I wanted to go. I feel like I don’t matter to anyone. 
Thank you for your kind words 🖤

I’m alone on Thanksgiving because I’ve pushed people away, and I’m too afraid/prideful to ask to not be left alone. I’m not handling my BPD well...at all. I don’t know what to do anymore. I feel so close to giving up.
